eubalaena-glacialis.title: North Atlantic right whale · detailed source-derived exterior
eubalaena-glacialis.author: Digital Life project, University of Massachusetts Amherst / CG artist Robert Gutierrez; northern interpretation and new materials by PhenoVoxel Archive
eubalaena-glacialis.surfaceType: Source-derived detailed exterior with original numeric albedo, normal and roughness maps
eubalaena-glacialis.delivery: Separate selected northern body, irregular raised callosities and new 4K skin atlas. Same detailed surface across finite local dorsoventral and turning studies.
eubalaena-glacialis.biology: A northern educational interpretation of a Southern right-whale reconstruction; not a northern specimen scan or a fitted physiological model. Ocean-basin species identity is not diagnosed by this selected body condition or callosity pattern.
eubalaena-glacialis.changes: Source pose baked into a static exterior; skeleton and creator animation omitted. Modest selected head/fullness changes, smooth coincident shading, independent non-overlapping UV charts and completely new numeric skin/callosity maps replace the Southern appearance. Dark eyes and hidden closed-mouth baleen retained. Original Southern asset is unchanged.

viewerRig.type: Static source-derived body with finite authored posterior flexion and orientation study
viewerRig.scope: Dorsoventral posterior bending and local turning only. No feeding, measured speed, forces, fluid solution or tissue mechanics.
